head: 13e2ca10
subject: RDS response header additions and removals
change: Route-level response_headers_to_add and response_headers_to_remove are decoded, retained by the selector, copied into owned RPC state, and applied to received response metadata. Unary responses rewrite the owned HTTP/2 head in Active.finish; streaming and duplex responses rewrite the head in ClientDuplex.beginResponse before gRPC status/body parsing. Additions support append, add-if-absent, overwrite and overwrite-if-exists; removals run first and names match case-insensitively. The original header block is freed only after the replacement block is fully allocated, so allocation failure leaves the original response intact for normal cleanup.

tests.decode_and_selection: src/grpc/xds/rds/tests.zig 'gRPC RDS owns literal response header mutations and removals' checks fields 10/11, action decoding and selection projection.
tests.owned_copy: src/grpc/channel/shared/request_inputs.zig 'shared request inputs apply xDS header mutations and removals' now includes response mutations/removals and verifies the owned copies survive the caller's source slices.
tests.wire: src/grpc/xds/rds/transport_tests.zig 'gRPC RDS rewrites path and authority on the wire' now sends x-response: original from the server, applies an RDS overwrite to mutated, and asserts the client's OwnedResponse headers contain mutated.

notes: Response mutation names still use the non-binary gRPC metadata rules, so grpc-status/message, content-type, te, pseudo-headers and -bin names are rejected. Regex/format rewrites, HTTP filter overrides and non-router filters remain open.
